dish: Hanagasa set / Okinawan teishoku with a choice of inamuruchi, nakami-jiru or soba soup, plus the house iced tea
w: A popular old-style shokudō off the Heiwa-dōri arcade serving Okinawan home cooking as set meals: pick white, brown or red (sekihan) rice and one of five soups including inamuruchi and nakami-jiru. Its sweet house iced tea is famous enough to have been sold in cartons.

dish: Bukubuku-cha (frothed rice-and-jasmine tea of the Ryūkyū court)
n: Uchinā Chaya Buku-Buku, Tsuboya (うちなー茶屋 ぶくぶく)
w: A small teahouse on Tsuboya's pottery street that whips bukubuku-cha, the frothy rice-and-jasmine tea with Ryūkyū-dynasty roots, in front of you. Named in Visit Okinawa's Naha guide.

n: COFFEE potohoto, Sakaemachi (コーヒー ポトホト)
w: A tiny self-roasting coffee stand inside the post-war Sakaemachi Market, whose owner placed 5th at the 2014 Japan Coffee Roasting Championship per Rurubu. Mapple names it among Sakaemachi's recommended stops.

n: Yagi Ryōri Misaki, Sakaemachi (山羊料理 美咲)
w: A goat-meat specialist in the Sakaemachi Market alleys — goat is a traditional Okinawan celebration food. Featured by both Stars and Stripes' Sakaemachi guide and Mapple's Sakaemachi restaurant roundup.

dish: Awamori, Okinawan craft beer and café plates
n: Sangoza Kitchen (さんご座キッチン)
w: A café-bar inside Sakurazaka Gekijō, Naha's historic art-house cinema, five minutes from the Heiwa-dōri market arcade, with a selection of awamori, beer, wine and sake. Mapple lists it among the Kokusai-dōri area's cheap-drinking (senbero) stops.

dish: Veggie taco rice and vegan tantan ramen
address: Matsuo 2-12-3, Naha, Okinawa (just south of Kokusai-dōri)
w: An organic vegetarian/vegan restaurant just south of Kokusai-dōri cooking with island-grown produce, such as Hateruma millet and Iriomote rice. Lunch runs to veggie taco rice and a vegan tantan ramen set; dinner is a multi-course menu.

dish: Sātā andāgī (Okinawan fried doughnuts) and Yumeiro zenzai
n: Ryūkyū Kashidokoro Ryūgū, Heiwa-dōri (琉球菓子処 琉宮 平和通り店)
w: A sātā andāgī specialist on the Heiwa-dōri market arcade off Kokusai-dōri, frying its own flour blend in plain, brown-sugar, coconut and black-sesame flavours. Stars and Stripes also singles out its big, colourful 'Yumeiro' zenzai shaved ice.

n: Okinawa Soba Naha-tei (沖縄そば 那覇亭)
w: An Okinawa soba shop in central Naha picked in Mapple's Naha soba feature and profiled by Japan Travel.
